name: twilio-video-node-examples
description: Dependencies for the examples. `@twilio/video-node-sdk` is used only outside a repo checkout; inside one, helpers/sdk.js prefers the local build. Every example mints an Access Token through helpers/token.js, which needs the `twilio` helper library. The computer-vision examples additionally need onnxruntime-node and @napi-rs/canvas. Install with `npm install` from this directory.
